notes.title: Project Status Update: The Count of Monte Cristo
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,


After careful consideration, I’ve decided to close active development on The Count of Monte Cristo.
This demo represents a fully playable concept, a standalone slice of what could have been. As a solo developer, I’ve chosen to focus my energy on a different project that’s now further along: a psychological horror game called The Last Transmission.

I’m proud of what was built, and grateful to everyone who supported the project. Though the full version of this game won’t be developed, the demo remains available as a finished glimpse into the world I wanted to explore.

Thanks again for playing.
